title: Sosucam sugar-worker strike and sit-in (wrong year)
notes: Search returned this 2025 issue while probing January 2023. The report’s fourth-quarter 2024 payroll context and 5 February 2025 issue date place the described January 27/29 action in 2025, not 2023. The roughly 3,000 workers are workforce size, not a documented simultaneous assembly count.

title: Return-on-title teacher selection protest notice
notes: The uploaded communiqué is dated 20 March 2023 and announces a peaceful demonstration for 3 April at the MINESUP and MINESEC esplanades. It documents earlier correspondence, including 30 January, but no January public gathering or later execution. Approximately 2,700 applicants is the pool that applied, not attendance.

title: ASEELEC extraordinary general assembly in Yaoundé
reason: The opened text describes a union members’ briefing and bylaw/name changes, not a protest or state-directed public demand; turnout is absent.
notes: Cameroon Tribune reports members were briefed on prior talks with Eneo, the Energy Ministry and ARSEL about payment and contract grievances. The subscriber-gated remainder was not read. A possible relation to the November 2022 subcontractor strike remains unverified in continuation C001.
